changes: Added DiscoveryFieldsRequestHandler and registered /discovery/fields in the default configset.
Kept counts local to one core and identified the response scope as local-core.
Committed the implementation and schema-snapshot alignment change; both commits are on the fork branch.

limitations: No focused automated test for DiscoveryFieldsRequestHandler is present in this branch.
The endpoint is a first-step local-core prototype; it does not provide distributed aggregation, statistics, facets, pivots, or production safety guarantees.
Linux compile and formatting proof is pending; the exact-head gate is records/gate/discovery-fields-linux-proof-20261116-r2.json.
summary: Implemented and pushed the first local-core populated-fields endpoint. The response reports actual indexed field names, resolved explicit or dynamic schema types, matching-document counts for q plus fq, and count source. It returns no field values or documents.
